items.summary: Recommendation: defer the MarkItDown prototype. The bounded draft-only prototype is technically isolatable, but current execution health is insufficient to justify new research scope: 124 approved proposals lack execution requests, 27 failed requests have open repairs, and 10 deployed improvements await measurement. Reconsider after backlog execution exceeds 50% or with explicit owner prioritization.

Recommendation: keep the Great American Lakes pilot in its existing measurement gate through 2026-10-06. Do not add a concurrent CRO or affiliate variant until the existing runs are reconciled. Unavailable revenue and causal lift must remain unavailable.

Recommendation: approve only bounded, single-site queue work with explicit ownership, isolated diffs, focused validation, and rollback. Do not retry failed work unchanged; repair evidence must identify the defect, validation gate, and rollback before requeue.

Recommendation: retain report-only finance reconciliation. The supplied telemetry supports known-cost and attribution-boundary reporting, but not site-level revenue, margin, CAC, payback, or ROI claims.
Prioritize repair triage for failed queue work. Requeue only after identifying the smallest defect, validation gate, and rollback. Do not retry failed work unchanged.
